# Bryce Logistics — Global View Logistics Lianyungang Branch

> Bryce Logistics (www.sinolyg.com) is the website of Bryce Lee, Sales Manager at Qingdao Global View Logistics Co., Ltd. Lianyungang Branch (GWL), a freight forwarder handling China export shipments from Lianyungang and Qingdao. Services include FCL and LCL ocean freight, air freight, trucking, export customs clearance and documents. Main destinations are India and Pakistan, the Middle East, Latin America (with own contracted space at Qingdao for Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean and South America) and Southeast Asia. Inquiries are handled in English and Spanish. The site does not publish freight rates; quotes are given per shipment.

## Route guides

- [China to India Ocean Freight: Kolkata, Nhava Sheva and Mundra](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-india-shipping): Key export points for common India ports: sailing schedule, destination charges, customs habits and peak-season space risk.
- [Lianyungang to India FCL Shipping: Shanghai Connections & Booking Checklist](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/lianyungang-to-india-fcl-shipping): Plan India-bound FCL from Lianyungang via Shanghai: destination ports, feeder connections, booking deadlines, free-time terms, consignee details and quote scope.
- [Lianyungang & Qingdao to Karachi Shipping: Ports, Terminals & Booking Guide](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-karachi-shipping): Compare Karachi Port and Port Qasim, KICT, KGTL, SAPT, QICT and the AICT off-dock facility.
- [Qingdao & Lianyungang to Middle East Shipping: Jebel Ali, Dammam & Jeddah](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-jebel-ali-shipping): Plan China exports from Qingdao or Lianyungang to Jebel Ali, Dammam and Jeddah.
- [China to South America Ocean Freight: Qingdao Contracted Space to Brazil, Argentina, Mexico & More](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-south-america-shipping): Qingdao contracted space and booking windows for both South America East and West coasts — Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Chile, Peru and more, with transit times, carriers and special cargo notes.
- [China to Brazil & Argentina Ocean Freight: South America East Coast, Qingdao Contracted Space](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-brazil-argentina-shipping): Qingdao contracted space, carriers, transit times and destination notes for South America East ports like Santos and Buenos Aires.
- [China to Mexico, Chile & Peru Ocean Freight: South America West Coast, Qingdao Own Space](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-mexico-chile-peru-shipping): Qingdao own space, carriers, transit times and notes for South America West ports like Manzanillo, San Antonio and Callao.
- [China to Central America & Caribbean Ocean Freight: Panama, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Jamaica & Dominican Republic](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-central-america-caribbean-shipping): Routing, transshipment hubs, transit references, carriers and booking notes for exports from Qingdao and Lianyungang to Central America and the Caribbean.
- [Lianyungang to Vietnam Ocean Freight: Ho Chi Minh, Hai Phong & Da Nang, Direct and Transshipment](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-vietnam-shipping): Direct and transshipment options, transit times, carriers and destination notes for Lianyungang exports to Ho Chi Minh, Hai Phong and Da Nang in Vietnam.
- [Lianyungang to Thailand Ocean Freight: Laem Chabang, Bangkok & Lat Krabang, Direct and Transshipment](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-thailand-shipping): Direct and transshipment options, transit times, carriers and destination notes for Lianyungang exports to Laem Chabang, Bangkok and Lat Krabang in Thailand.
- [Lianyungang to Philippines Ocean Freight: Manila, Cebu, Davao & More, via Transshipment](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-philippines-shipping): Transshipment options, transit times, carriers and destination notes for Lianyungang exports to Manila, Cebu, Davao, Cagayan, Batangas and more in the Philippines.
- [Lianyungang to Indonesia Ocean Freight: Jakarta, Surabaya & Semarang, Direct and Transshipment](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-indonesia-shipping): Direct and transshipment options, transit times, carriers and destination notes for Lianyungang exports to Jakarta, Surabaya, Semarang and more in Indonesia.
- [Lianyungang to Malaysia Ocean Freight: Port Klang, Pasir Gudang & Kuantan, Direct and Transshipment](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/routes/china-to-malaysia-shipping): Direct and transshipment options, transit times, carriers and destination notes for Lianyungang exports to Port Klang, Pasir Gudang, Kuantan and more in Malaysia.

## Shipping guides

- [FCL Export Booking and Shipment Data Checklist](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/requirements/fcl-export-checklist): What information is needed before booking a China export FCL shipment: cargo details, container type, cut-off, trucking, customs and bill of lading checks.
- [LCL Export Checklist: Volume, Warehouse Entry and Destination Charges](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/requirements/lcl-export-checklist): LCL export is useful for small shipments, but chargeable volume, warehouse rules, destination charges and documents need to be checked early.
- [China Export Customs and Document Checklist](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/requirements/customs-documents): A practical guide to customs documents, bill of lading details, certificates, inspection and special cargo paperwork before booking.
- [What Is Included in an Ocean Freight Quote?](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/guides/ocean-freight-cost-breakdown): Break down China export ocean freight quotes into ocean freight, surcharges, trucking, customs, documents and destination charges.
- [China Export Freight Market Notes: Space Trends for Southeast Asia, India-Pakistan, Middle East & South America](https://www.sinolyg.com/en/guides/china-export-freight-market-notes): Regularly updated notes on space and timing for exports from Lianyungang and Qingdao to Southeast Asia, India-Pakistan, the Middle East and South America.
